excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content:
<dannyryan> Good question
In practice, currently you cant know until EL is synced
If you are both synced, moving into transition, all good
If you arent, then some edge cases emerge. In practice, you'd get a SYNCING response
You can either optimistically go forward if attestations say so. Or you can block
In most cases, we suggest going forward and waiting for EL to eventually sync and tell you things
In this case, we might want to block but by default rn, go forward
I'll take some notes on the tradeoffs at this precise case shortly
